targetSpec.biochemConstraints: MW 250-600; P1 glutamine mimic preferred; synthetic steps <=6
targetSpec.pharmacophoreRules: S1 pocket GLU166 H-bond; catalytic dyad proximity CYS145/HIS41

description.en: Structure-based 3CLpro seed: primary amide P1 glutamine mimic is oriented to hydrogen-bond with GLU166 and the S1 pocket, while the peptidyl nitrile warhead is placed for reversible covalent engagement with CYS145 near the CYS145/HIS41 catalytic dyad. The naphthylacetyl hydrophobic group supports binding and keeps MW, logP, polarity, and synthetic complexity within the requested limits.

seo_description.en: Deterministic physics-based computational validation of 3CLpro inhibitor complexes using RDKit pharmacophore filtering, Glide docking, OpenMM 8.2 explicit-solvent molecular dynamics, and MM-GBSA. Reports binding free energy of -10.26 kcal/mol and average RMSD of 1.563 Å for Tier-2 50ns Gold MD.
seo_description.zh: 基于确定性物理计算的3CLpro抑制剂复合物验证，采用RDKit药团过滤、Glide对接、OpenMM 8.2显式溶剂分子动力学及MM-GBSA。报告结合自由能为-10.26 kcal/mol，Tier-2 50ns Gold MD平均RMSD为1.563 Å。
seo_description.ja: RDKitファルコフィアフィルタリング、Glideドッキング、OpenMM 8.2顯式溶媒分子動力学、MM-GBSAを用いた3CLpro阻害剤複合体の決定論的物理解算検証。結合自由エネルギー-10.26 kcal/mol、Tier-2 50ns Gold MD平均RMSD 1.563 Åを報告。
seo_description.de: Deterministische physikalisch basierte Validierung von 3CLpro-Inhibitor-Komplexen mittels RDKit-Pharmakophor-Filterung, Glide-Docking, OpenMM 8.2 explizit-solvatisierter Molekulardynamik und MM-GBSA.
